## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks, raw record

Run 6 follows n≈+3.20×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 from 0 to 10 T; run 7 follows n≈−1.20×10¹² cm⁻², D≈0 from 10 to 0.3 T on the same hardwired B_1–B_2 pair (run-5 calibration, absolute density scale tied to hBN geometry). Plot the measured four-probe resistance, drain current and both gate currents before extracting oscillation frequencies.

from hera.analysis import resolve_channels
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(13, 7))
for row, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid)
    channels = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    I = r.col('sr0_X') / channels['sr0'].gain
    R = np.abs((r.col('sr1_X') / channels['sr1'].gain) / I)
    ax[row, 0].plot(B, R, lw=.8)
    ax[row, 1].plot(B, I * 1e9, lw=.8)
    ax[row, 2].plot(B, r.col('k_2400_tg_curr') * 1e12, lw=.8, label='TG')
    ax[row, 2].plot(B, r.col('k_2400_bg_curr') * 1e12, lw=.8, label='BG')
    ax[row, 0].set(ylabel='|Rxx| (Ω)', title=f'data/{rid}: raw Rxx')
    ax[row, 1].set(ylabel='drain current (nA)', title='measured current')
    ax[row, 2].set(ylabel='gate current (pA)', title='gate leakage')
    for a in ax[row]: a.set_xlabel('B (T)'); a.grid(alpha=.2)
    ax[row, 2].legend()
    print(f'data/{rid}: {r.rows} rows, interrupted={r.interrupted}; B {B[0]:.2f}→{B[-1]:.2f} T; '
          f'|Rxx| {R.min():.1f}–{R.max():.1f} Ω; I {I.min()*1e9:.3f}–{I.max()*1e9:.3f} nA; '
          f'T {r.col("T_sample").min():.3f}–{r.col("T_sample").max():.3f} K; '
          f'max |I_TG| {np.max(np.abs(r.col("k_2400_tg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA; '
          f'max |I_BG| {np.max(np.abs(r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")))*1e12:.0f} pA')
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — SdH spectra and decision for the fan

Both spots have resolved B-dependent structure and maintain ≈10 nA drain current with gate leakage below 0.22 nA. Compare FFT windows because the strong smooth magnetoresistance and the short high-field 1/B span can make harmonics or background residuals look like extra pockets. The frequency read is a guide to fan sampling, not a stacking verdict.

from scipy.signal import find_peaks
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), sharex=True)
for row, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    R = np.abs((r.col('sr1_X') / ch['sr1'].gain) / (r.col('sr0_X') / ch['sr0'].gain))
    for lo in (1.5, 2.0, 3.0):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(lo, 10.0), nfft=2048, bg_degree=3, log=False)
        y = spec[0]; ax[row].plot(f, y / np.max(y), label=f'{lo:g}–10 T')
        if lo == 2.0:
            peaks, _ = find_peaks(y)
            peaks = sorted((k for k in peaks if 3 < f[k] < 40), key=lambda k: y[k], reverse=True)[:4]
            print(f'data/{rid} FFT 2–10 T local maxima:', [(round(float(f[k]), 1), round(float(y[k]/np.max(y)), 2)) for k in peaks])
    ax[row].set(xlim=(0, 45), ylabel='normalized FFT', title=f'data/{rid}: detrended Rxx, 1/B FFT')
    ax[row].legend(); ax[row].grid(alpha=.2)
ax[-1].set_xlabel('frequency (T)'); fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

**Read / next step (plan steps 3→4):** data/6 is strongly oscillatory: the broad high-field feature reaches 530 Ω near 9 T, and a 7–8 T FFT component persists across windows. Peaks around 14–30 T may be its harmonics; the second series region identified in data/5 can also contribute shifted tones. data/7 reaches 587 Ω at 10 T and has several oscillations with 5–13 T window-dependent spectral peaks. A single B trace cannot assign those peaks to independent 4LG pockets or to the two CNP regions. A fixed-D, density-resolved Landau fan is justified; it should track line slopes and intercepts across the same operating box. No stacking call yet.

## HERA — Step 4: D≈0 Landau fan on B_1–B_2 (`landau-fan`)

> **05:24** · Landau fan: B 0→10 T, 48 rows; D≈0, n −1.20→+3.20e12 cm−2, 111 points/row; TG/BG co-sweep; sr1 200 µV, τ 0.1 s; B1−B2 · **ETA ~09:04** (≈3h40m)

Runs 6 and 7 show strong oscillations on both sides of the CNP, but their FFT peaks shift with the fit window and run 5 has two parallel CNP ridges. A density-resolved fan on the sole hardwired pair is the next discriminant: follow the run-5 D≈0 calibration from n=−1.20 to +3.20×10¹² cm⁻² while B rises 0→10 T. This covers both spot densities and stays inside all gate and field validators. The last ≈0.07×10¹² on the hole edge is excluded to keep TG ≈23 mV above its −0.3 V limit; the price of that edge is at most two density samples. Absolute n still uses the 9.5 nm hBN thickness prior.

Preflight reads the live thermometry logfiles, base T, field near 0, Si at 0, heaters off, magnet output/switch, bias drive and gate pacing; it stops on a mismatch. Set SR0/SR1 τ=0.1 s and wait 1.0 s per gate point (10τ at 24 dB/oct), then restore τ after the sweep. Hold sr1 sensitivity at 200 µV (≈20 kΩ full scale at 10 nA), monitor both gate currents, measured drain current and temperatures, and stop on >1 nA leakage or a base-T excursion. The field set is blocking at 0.137 T/min: 10 T costs at least 73 min; data/5 measured 1.10 s/point with 1 s delay and ≈5.8 s row turnaround, so 48×111 points plus dual-gate writes and margin price this at ≈3 h 40 m. The fan ends at 10 T for a possible ride-down; gates remain at the last density.

Checkpoints: inspect the first two completed rows for leakage, rail/clipping, live temperature and a responsive Rxx channel; then inspect at ≈2, 4, 6 and 8 T for useful Landau trajectories and continued headroom. Interrupt on leakage, sustained clipping or a dead channel; re-read the actual field and gates after any interruption. The run-5 second CNP ridge means a doubled fan may still be a series-region effect, so the verdict will depend on trajectory shifts and filling sequence, not branch count alone. (Plan step 4; calibrating runs data/5–7.)

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan`): D≈0, n -1.20..+3.20e12, B 0->10 T, B_1-B_2 ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Preconditions: state assumed but not set by the fan.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
_Si, _sr, _vr = k_si(), heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
_drive, _freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
print(f'precondition: T_sample={_Ts:.3f} K (1.0..1.5), T_vaporizer={_Tv:.3f} K (<1.6), '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T (|B|<0.02), Si={_Si:+.4f} V (0), heater ranges={_sr}/{_vr} (0/0), '
      f'PS={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output={magnet.output_enabled()}, '
      f'drive={_drive:.3f} V at {_freq:.3f} Hz (1 V, 13.777 Hz), '
      f'gate step={k_tg.volt.step}/{k_bg.volt.step} V, NPLC={k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()}')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_B) < 0.02 and abs(_Si) < 0.01
assert _sr == 0 and _vr == 0 and magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(_drive - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_freq - 13.777) < 0.01
assert k_tg.volt.step == 0.005 and k_bg.volt.step == 0.005 and k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert dc205.voltage_range() == 2 and dc205.output() == 1 and abs(dc205.ramp_rate - 0.5) < 1e-9
def _bounds(v): return (float(v._min_value), float(v._max_value))
assert _bounds(k_tg.volt.vals) == (-0.3, 1.0) and _bounds(k_bg.volt.vals) == (-1.3, 2.0)
assert _bounds(k_si.vals) == (-25.0, 25.0) and _bounds(dc205.voltage.vals) == (-25.0, 25.0)
assert _bounds(magnet.field.vals) == (-10.0, 10.0) and B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0
assert _bounds(heater.sample_setpoint.vals) == (0.0, 100.0) and _bounds(heater.vaporizer_setpoint.vals) == (0.0, 100.0)

# Region-A calibration from data/5: ratio fitted to CNP ridge, scale anchored by top-hBN geometry.
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
           n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.round(np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111), 4)  # 1e12 cm^-2, 0.04 spacing
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, np.zeros_like(n_vec), **CAL)
n_check, D_check = calc_nD(Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec, **CAL)
assert np.max(np.abs(n_check-n_vec)) < 1e-6 and np.max(np.abs(D_check)) < 1e-6
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX
B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.r_[np.arange(0.0, 1.0, 0.5), np.arange(1.0, 10.0001, 0.2)], 4))
assert len(B_vec) == 48 and B_vec[0] == 0 and B_vec[-1] == 10 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
print(f'grid: {len(B_vec)} B rows x {len(n_vec)} densities = {len(B_vec)*len(n_vec)} points; '
      f'B {B_vec[0]:.1f}->{B_vec[-1]:.1f} T, n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}->{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12; '
      f'TG {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}->{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V; BG {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}->{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V')

# Reduce τ to allow a full 10τ gate settle in 1 s. Restore these instrument settings on completion or interrupt.
_tau0, _tau1 = sr0.time_constant(), sr1.time_constant()
assert sr0.filter_slope() == 24 and sr1.filter_slope() == 24
sr0.time_constant(0.1); sr1.time_constant(0.1)
try:
    sr1.sensitivity(200e-6)  # 20 kOhm FS at 10 nA; CNP and QH headroom.
    print(f'lock-ins: SR0/SR1 tau={sr0.time_constant()}/{sr1.time_constant()} s, '
          f'SR1 sensitivity={sr1.sensitivity()} V (~{sr1.sensitivity()/(_drive/100e6):.0f} Ohm FS)')
    mc = dict(meas_config); mc['Si (V)'] = _Si; mc['sample_temperature:'] = _Ts
    mc['comments'] = (f'landau-fan D=0, n -1.20..+3.20e12 (111 x 0.04e12), B 0..10 T (48 rows, 0.2 T above 1 T); '
                      f'run-5 cal c_bg/c_tg={CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset={CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, '
                      f'D_offset={CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f} V/nm; sr1 sens 200 uV, tau 0.1 s, dwell 1.0 s')
    s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
    s.add_comment('landau-fan')
    s.add_comment(f'D=0 region-A calibrated density n {n_vec[0]:+.2f}..{n_vec[-1]:+.2f}e12 (111); '
                  f'B 0..10 T (48 rows); TG {Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vtg_vec.max():+.4f} V, '
                  f'BG {Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}..{Vbg_vec.max():+.4f} V; Si=0; sr1 200 uV')
    s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbg_vec[0])); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtg_vec[0]))
    interruptible_sleep(10)

    # row layout: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, Ts, Tv, Itg, Ibg, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P
    s.fp(T_sample).fp(T_vaporizer).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
    s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
    s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X)
    s.plot('time', sr1.P); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
    s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
    s.plot('time', T_sample); s.plot('time', T_vaporizer)

    def safety_guard(station, data):
        if abs(float(data[6])) > 1e-9 or abs(float(data[7])) > 1e-9 or not 1.0 <= float(data[4]) <= 1.6:
            print(f'TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: '
                  f'T={float(data[4]):.3f} K, Itg={float(data[6]):+.3e} A, Ibg={float(data[7]):+.3e} A')
            station.interrupt_requested = True
    s.register_run_after(safety_guard, ())
    s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                     slow_delay=0.0, fast_delay=1.0, init_delay=False)
finally:
    sr0.time_constant(_tau0); sr1.time_constant(_tau1)
print(f'done: B={magnet.field():+.4f} T, TG={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, BG={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V, '
      f'T_sample={T_sample():.3f} K; tau restored {_tau0}/{_tau1} s')

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
